alerts.reason: Slot A reports Q3 net sales growth, but slot B says volumes fell 10% year on year in Q3 and 9% over the first three quarters. If that volume weakness persists and price or mix offsets less of it, reported net sales could fall at least 5% in either of the next two quarters.

Slot A reports Q1 revenue down 3.7% year on year and LTL tons down 11.9%. With revenue just 1.3 percentage points above the threshold, a modest further loss of tonnage or a smaller offset from revenue per ton could push the decline to 5% in Q2 or Q3.
